people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
translations.bsb: Therefore, go! I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites out of Egypt.”
translations.kjv: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
translations.asv: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
